Container.Name: Unraid-PWA
Container.Overview: Open-source, self-hostable PWA to monitor and control Unraid via its GraphQL API. Default URL: http://[IP]:[PORT:2442] Includes GPU load, VRAM, temperature, power, fan, encoder/decoder and active-app readings; CPU and motherboard temperatures; and native Docker update status and controls when the API supports them. NVIDIA access is enabled by default and requires the Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin. On hosts without NVIDIA support, remove --gpus all from Extra Parameters before applying. For live GPU stats, set GPU Server URL to the exact Unraid API URL saved inside the app, including scheme and port. Do not use the PWA dashboard URL on port 2442. If Active Apps is unavailable or misses known workloads, optionally append --pid=host to Extra Parameters (keep --gpus all). This shares the host process namespace with NVIDIA tools. The read-only Host Process Names mapping only resolves returned process names; it does not enable host PID visibility. See README for diagnostic commands. Docker Overview shows the update count, list, and a confirmed sequential Update all action. Keep the tab open; the queue stops if an update cannot be confirmed.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Unraid-PWA web interface.

Config.Name: GPU Server URL
Config.Description: For live NVIDIA stats, copy the exact Unraid API server URL saved inside the PWA, including http/https and port. This is the Unraid connection address, NOT the PWA dashboard URL on port 2442. Leave blank to disable local NVIDIA stats.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA GPUs exposed to the container: all, or a specific GPU UUID. Requires the Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin and --gpus all in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: utility enables nvidia-smi and NVML for read-only GPU statistics.

Config.Name: UNRAID_BFF_ALLOW_SELF_SIGNED
Config.Description: Allow self-signed certs for Unraid server connections (true/false).

Config.Name: UNRAID_BFF_TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set true if you run behind a reverse proxy (or specific proxy mode if supported).

Config.Name: UNRAID_BFF_ORIGIN
Config.Description: CORS allowlist. Usually leave default when accessing via http://<UNRAID-IP>:2442.

Config.Name: UNRAID_BFF_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: Optional override. If empty, the app generates /app/data/encryption.key.

Config.Name: Host Hardware Sensors
Config.Description: Read-only host sysfs for CPU and motherboard temperatures. Requires loaded hardware-monitoring drivers on Unraid.

Config.Name: Host Process Names
Config.Description: Optional read-only host process mapping to resolve GPU active-app names. The app only reads short process names.

Config.Name: Local Hardware Server URL
Config.Description: Exact Unraid API URL of this container host. Leave blank to use GPU Server URL. Local sensor readings are only shown when this server is selected.

Config.Name: CPU Sensor Override
Config.Description: Optional exact hwmon chip:tempN selector, e.g. coretemp:temp1. Leave blank for automatic CPU package selection.

Config.Name: Motherboard Sensor Override
Config.Description: Optional exact hwmon chip:tempN selector for the motherboard sensor. Unlabeled sensors require an explicit selector; see README.
